punchline: Thor did not outrun the fast traders; it made its own orders arrive together.
thirty_sec: After taking over RBC's electronic trading desk in 2009, Brad Katsuyama saw 10,000-share buys fill only in part while prices rose elsewhere; his team built Thor, which delayed each sub-order so all reached the exchanges at the same moment, to the microsecond.
question: Which recurring loss are you waiting on others to fix, when one step of yours could be timed differently?
key_contrast: Change your own timing, not the market.
